title: [Advisory] PTC Windchill and FlexPLM: Critical RCE via Deserialization (CVE-2026-126325)
content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation allows remote attackers to achieve remote code execution and potentially full system compromise via crafted network requests containing malicious serialized data.
- **Current exploitation status**: UNKNOWN

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- PTC Windchill
- PTC FlexPLM
For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Prerequisites:** Network access to the exposed Windchill or FlexPLM system
- **Available Mitigations:**
    - Vendor patches available (automatically applied for PTC-hosted environments)

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:
- CVE-2026-126325 CVSS4.0: 9.2 (CRITICAL) - Deserialization of untrusted data leading to remote code execution

##### REFERENCES:
Primary:
- Vendor Advisory: https://www.ptc.com/en/support/article/CS483249 (Behind a customer login)

Supporting:
- News Coverage: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/ptc-patches-critical-windchill-and.html

*Timestamp of the Information: 12.11.2026, 16:00*
summary: A critical security vulnerability has been disclosed in PTC's Windchill and FlexPLM product lifecycle management software that allows attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely. The flaw stems from the improper deserialization of untrusted data, potentially granting malicious actors deep access to targeted manufacturing and industrial enterprise networks to disrupt processes or exfiltrate proprietary data.
